            "sha256": "491d9f53bdcb591157fb9d4b5a8b2c2be794a19dd3f673c89dacb0d469fe6ca2",
            "text": "Channel: phone_note\nTimestamp: 2025-02-20T13:00:00+01:00\nFrom: Riley Foster <riley.foster@mailbox.ch>\nTo: Protekta Rechtsberatung <fallaufnahme@protekta.ch>\n\nGood afternoon\n\nAs I understand it: The living room is around 16 degrees in the morning; After a reset the heating works briefly and stops again; I have called three times; this is how I recorded it.\n\nRegarding \"repeated heating failure\", my notes show: the calibrated temperature remains unresolved; for the request \"lasting repair and review of possible remedies\": I have included everything currently available to me; on \"repeated heating failure\", I want clarity before acting; also unresolved: the service cause; I cannot currently support anything further.\n\nI am specifically asking for: lasting repair and review of possible remedies; in particular, I need clarity about the service cause and whether the records support an initial assessment.\n\nMy first note about it is dated 01 February 2025.\n\nThank you for clarifying; Before acting I need to know the calibrated temperature; I want to base what I do on that.\n\nBest regards\n"

            "text": "Synthetic demonstration document (fictional)\nSource date: 2025-02-21\nReview as-of: 2025-02-21\n\nI, Riley Foster, am the tenant under an indefinite ordinary residential lease for Synthetic Rosenweg 33, 8008 Zurich, canton Zurich.             "text": "Synthetic demonstration document (fictional)\nSource date: 2025-02-21\nReview as-of: 2025-02-21\n\nService author: Mira Keller, building-heating technician.\nProperty: Synthetic Rosenweg 33, 8008 Zurich\n\nOn 2025-02-21 at07:30, a calibrated digital instrument (calibration check2024-12-15, uncertainty±0.2C) measured the living room at15.8C after overnight normal operation.
